messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency for /v1/stream in us-west-2 spiked from ~420ms to ~2.3s over the last 3m. Paging on-call :pager: https://dash.internal/alerts/4743219876
alice: oncall alice here, looking at dashboards and traces now. pulling up live spans.
dave: dash: https://dash.internal/streams/p99?range=5m — tail concentrated on worker-queue + nginx upstream queue in us-west-2, saw a few >1s upstream waits.
carol: runtime view: KV cache miss-rate jumped to ~58%, worker runtime queue >120, multiple long model forwards (~1.8s) for sequences >1024 tokens. no immediate OOMs.
ben: any recent deploys or config changes?
deploy-bot: INFO: roll/redwood-runtime 3.13.0 fully rolled in us-west-2 ~10m ago (ci/3134) :deploy:
alice: ok i'll run quick mitigations: 1) scale streaming pool +6 replicas, 2) enable fallback routing to redwood-small-v2 for tail reqs, 3) throttle seq>1024. executing scale now.
alice: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/scale -H 'Authorization: Bearer **' -d '{'pool':'streaming-usw2','delta_replicas':6}'
```
carol: recommend disabling continuous batching for streaming for ~20m (reduces tail variance; cost up). config patch suggestion:
```
PATCH /runtime/config
{'streaming': {'continuous_batching': false}}
```
alice: applied scale + enabled fallback + disabled batching. early numbers: p99 down to ~720ms after ~90s :chart_with_downwards_trend: still above SLO but trending down.
eve: support check — any customer-facing errors? which orgs affected?
dave: quick impact: ~23 requests breached SLO in last 10m, hitting 5 orgs; largest org saw ~15% tail degradation. no increase in 5xxs, mostly latency.
ben: good triage. keep live mitigations for 30m, collect traces and span samples. if p99 doesn't fall under 600ms, prepare rollback to 3.12.0. i'm taking ownership and will coordinate infra/runtime.
alice: handing off to ben at 4743219960 UTC — i've attached logs and the command history to the incident tracker.
ben: taking ownership. creating #incident/4743219876 and linking runbook: https://runbook.internal/stream-tail. will post updates every 10m.
incident-bot: NOTE: Pager silence for alice until handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
ben: next steps: keep fallback routing enabled, watch kv-miss-rate, run targeted heap-check on worker-12, and collect p95/p99 trends for next 30m. tagging runtime-eng and oncall.
carol: i'll prep a revert plan for 3.13.0 and a kernel-dump request if worker-12 repeats long forwards.
ben: ack — escalations if regressions reappear. logging initial triage + mitigation timeline into tracker.
